title: CyberIncidentDisclosure
description: Artifact A of cyber-disclosure-readiness: 8-K Item 1.05 trigger and disclosure-decision pack. Wraps the materiality workpaper, the disclosure draft, the parallel-clocks table, the DCP trace, and the sign-off block. Consumed downstream by the disclosure-committee minutes system, the SEC reporting workflow, and the risk-committee-pack cyber heat-map cell.

incident_id.description: Stable internal ID for the incident. Not the SEC filing accession number.

scope_id.description: Links to scoping record if supplied.

detection_date.description: When the firm first detected the incident.

materiality_determination_date.description: When the disclosure committee determined materiality. Null if pending. Drives disclosure_clock_start and disclosure_filing_due.

materiality_basis_qualitative.description: Discrete qualitative factors. Reputational, regulatory, strategic, competitive.

aggregation_with_prior_incidents.description: References to incident_id of related prior incidents considered under Item 1.05 Instruction 1. Empty array means no related occurrences identified; document analysis in materiality_aggregation_analysis.

materiality_aggregation_analysis.description: Narrative of the aggregation analysis under Instruction 1 to Item 1.05. Required when aggregation_with_prior_incidents is non-empty; recommended otherwise.

materiality_determined_by_role.description: Role of the person or body that made the determination. Disclosure committee chair (with securities counsel input) is the standard composition.

disclosure_clock_start.description: Equal to materiality_determination_date when determination is 'material'. Null when determination is 'not-material' or 'pending'.

disclosure_filing_due.description: 4 business days from disclosure_clock_start. Null when clock has not started.

delay_provision_invoked.description: Whether the US Attorney General delay provision under Item 1.05(c) is invoked.

delay_basis.description: AG notification rationale and process record. Required when delay_provision_invoked is true.

regulator.description: e.g., 'SEC (8-K Item 1.05)', 'OCC (12 CFR Part 53)', 'FRB (12 CFR Part 225 Subpart N)', 'FDIC (12 CFR Part 304 Subpart C)', 'NYDFS (23 NYCRR Part 500 §500.17)', 'SEC (Reg S-P 17 CFR Part 248.30)', 'state breach-notification — [state]', 'HIPAA HHS OCR', 'FINRA Rule 4530', 'state DOI ([state])', 'counterparty contractual'.

clock_basis.description: e.g., '4 business days from materiality determination', '36 hours from determination of notification incident', '72 hours from determination of cybersecurity event', '30 days from awareness of unauthorized access'.

item_105_draft_text.description: The 8-K body draft, structured into the four required elements (nature, scope, timing, material impact or reasonably likely material impact). Forensic detail and remediation specifics belong elsewhere. Null until materiality_determination is 'material'.

amendment_reasonably_foreseeable.description: Per Item 1.05(b), whether amendment is reasonably foreseeable as material new information becomes available. Null if not yet assessed.

verification_flags_carried_forward.description: Items that carry [verify section], [verify current effectiveness], or [verify pin cite] and require resolution before final filing.
